# PC110Core provenance

This directory vendors the portable C emulator core from:

- Repository: https://github.com/ahmadexp/PC110-EMU
- Commit: `81235b5fdf7d17ae180fc5cb6148e44bcbb87b4c`
- Imported: 2026-08-13

Only the public header and C implementation are included. No ROM, firmware,
font, DOS, PersonaWare, or disk image is bundled with PC110 Atlas.
